verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's own rollback docs say a Worker can be rolled back to a previously deployed version from either the dashboard or Wrangler. The `wrangler rollback` command targets a specified version, which covers both the one-click dashboard path and choosing a version. Missing for 10: detail on the dashboard's one-click flow, documentation of how far back versions can be restored ("any previous version" scope or limits), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can roll back a deployed service to any previous version in one click

citations.quote: You can roll back to a previously deployed version of your Worker using Wrangler or the Cloudflare dashboard.
To roll back to a specified version of your Worker via Wrangler, use the [`wrangler rollback`](/workers/wrangler/commands/general/#rollback) command.
